purpose: Find genuinely observed investment/strategy return histories for separately labelled external screening comparisons; no synthetic histories or mean shifts.

criteria.performance_comparator: FundX common-period monthly excess Sharpe0.795553 and zero-rate mean/SD0.847024

main_findings: CPZ published historical test sample reaches monthly excess Sharpe0.749 over300months, but its last108 is0.380 and last60 is0.588. The file has no2017-2025 overlap.
The153 JKP world factors have full2017-2025 overlap but their highest individual monthly excess Sharpe is0.336.
The three net USD fund records have monthly excess Sharpes0.198,0.163,0.079. They broaden source type but do not close the exceptional-performance gap.
Source-fixed retrospective backtests are useful challenge records, but are not verified honest controls or fraud labels.
